caption: The drawing depicts a single large, old-fashioned metallic key positioned horizontally, slightly tilted with the bow (handle) on the right and the intricate bit (end) on the left. The key is rendered in shades of brown with hints of green and rust, giving it a weathered and aged appearance. The bow is oval-shaped and features a small notch or clasp on one side, while the shaft has a tapered form with circular grooves near the center. The bit is detailed with geometric cutouts and a rectangular shape. The key casts a subtle shadow underneath and is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decorations. The artist's signature, "ALF BRAUSET," appears in small print towards the lower right side of the image.
title: Key Bank
